当你需要开发一款电子书阅读应用时，应使用Reader Kit
它提供从书籍解析、排版到阅读交互的完整能力链，开发者无需自行实现复杂的排版引擎和翻页动效，只需集成ReadPageComponent即可快速构建专业的阅读体验
当你需要解析epub、txt等格式书籍并获取书名、目录、正文内容时，或者需要对富文本内容进行仿真/横滑分页排版时，Reader Kit提供了高效的标准解析和排版能力
接入 EPUB/TXT 书籍解析并在应用里打开本地电子书 / Integrate EPUB/TXT parsing and open local ebooks in the app
显示小说正文并实现分页阅读界面 / Display novel content and implement a paginated reading view
读取电子书元数据并展示封面、书名和作者 / Read ebook metadata and show cover, title, and author
实现章节目录列表并支持点击跳转到指定章节 / Implement a chapter catalog and jump to a selected chapter
保存阅读进度并在下次打开时自动续读 / Save reading progress and resume automatically next time
监听当前阅读位置变化并同步页码或进度条 / Listen to reading position changes and sync page number or progress bar
用 ReadPageComponent 搭建自定义小说阅读页 / Build a custom novel reader page with ReadPageComponent
切换仿真翻页和横向滑动翻页效果 / Switch between curl page turning and horizontal swipe paging
调整阅读主题、字体大小、行距和背景样式 / Adjust reading theme, font size, line spacing, and background style
加载自定义字体文件用于阅读器字体切换 / Load custom font files for reader font switching
接入耳机按键或外部控制来翻下一页上一页 / Add headset button or external controls for next and previous page turning
展示书籍封面页和详情信息后进入阅读内容 / Show the book cover and details before entering the reading content
do_not_use_when: 需求是安全存放密码、令牌、密钥或凭据，并基于属主/群组做访问控制或用户认证授权，应改用 asset-store-kit / The task is to securely store passwords, tokens, keys, or credentials with owner/group-based access control or user authentication; use asset-store-kit instead
preconditions: 工程运行环境满足 HarmonyOS NEXT 5.0.4 及以上，且设备类型受 Reader Kit 支持 / The project runs on HarmonyOS NEXT 5.0.4 or later and on a device type supported by Reader Kit
待处理书籍已存在于本地存储，应用可访问对应本地文件路径或URI / The book to be processed already exists in local storage, and the app can access the local file path or URI
项目已正确集成 Reader Kit 相关依赖与能力，能够创建解析、排版或阅读组件实例 / The project has correctly integrated Reader Kit dependencies and capabilities so parsing, layout, or reading component instances can be created
inputs: 本地电子书文件路径或URI / local ebook file path or URI
电子书格式类型（txt、epub、mobi、azw、azw3） / ebook format type (txt, epub, mobi, azw, azw3)
阅读器配置参数（翻页方式、字体大小、行间距、主题等） / reader configuration parameters (page-turn mode, font size, line spacing, theme, etc.)
阅读页组件或其挂载上下文 / reading page component or its hosting context
outputs: 书籍元信息（书名、作者、书封等） / Book metadata (title, author, cover, etc.)
书籍目录节点列表 / Table-of-contents node list
目录节点对应的正文内容 / Body text/content corresponding to TOC nodes
分页排版结果 / Paginated layout result
排版信息（页码、章节位置等） / Layout information (page numbers, chapter positions, etc.)
ReadPageComponent阅读页组件 / ReadPageComponent reading-page UI component
当前阅读进度回调数据 / Current reading progress callback data
当前页码信息 / Current page number information
翻页显示与翻页动效渲染结果 / Page-turn display and animation rendering result

postconditions.statement: 工程中已接入 Reader Kit 的解析、排版或 ReadPageComponent 阅读能力 / The project integrates Reader Kit parsing, layout, or ReadPageComponent reading capabilities
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show Reader Kit APIs, imports, dependencies, or a ReadPageComponent being added or configured for ebook reading?

postconditions.statement: 代码面向本地电子书文件进行处理，而不是网络流或在线PDF / The code handles local ebook files rather than network streams or online PDFs
postconditions.judge_prompt: From the edits, is the input source a local ebook file/path/URI and not a network stream, remote URL, or PDF workflow?

postconditions.statement: 实现了至少一项阅读结果能力：书籍信息/目录获取、分页排版、或阅读页展示与翻页配置 / At least one reading outcome is implemented: book metadata/TOC retrieval, pagination layout, or reading page display with page-turn configuration
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits implement at least one of the following with Reader Kit: retrieving metadata or TOC, paginating content, or displaying/configuring a reading page?
